President Donald Trump hosted his third cryptocurrency gala for top holders of his meme coin at the Trump National golf club in Sterling, Virginia, on Sunday night. The event brought together a couple dozen men in suits and featured speeches from boxing champion Floyd Mayweather, Shark Tank investor Kevin O'Leary, and former NBA star Tristan Thompson.

## COLD

## TITLE
A: From Void News, this is On Air. It's Monday, November twenty-third.
B: Today: Iran Vows to Confront United States Naval Blockade With Available Tools. And Trump Hosts Meme Coin Gala.

## LEAD | Iran Vows to Confront United States
A: Iran announced on Monday that it would use all available means to counter a United States naval blockade imposed during the ongoing conflict. Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei stated during a press briefing in Tehran that the economic sanctions and naval blockade constitute military aggression, and that Iran is entitled to use any means for self-defense under Article 51 of the United Nations Charter.
A: Baghaei stated that Iran remains capable of restoring safety to the Strait of Hormuz within the shortest possible time if Washington fulfills conditions including an end to hostilities, the lifting of the blockade, and the waiving of sanctions. The announcement follows statements by United States President Donald Trump warning that Iranian vessels attempting to breach the naval blockade would be sent to the bottom of the sea, and reporting that Iran launched more drones and missiles in the past week than at any time for over a year.
B: Meanwhile, Iranian military officials announced that four oil tankers struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, including two traveling under United States military protection and two others that attempted to cross along an uncoordinated route. Shipping data shows crude oil shipments through the waterway fell in November, while reported attacks on shipping reached high levels since the war began in late February.
B: British endurance athlete Lewis Pugh completed a three-day swim through the Strait of Hormuz during which he reported hearing explosions from nearby tanker attacks. RT and Al Arabiya emphasize the Iranian military announcement regarding four oil tankers striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

## SECOND | Trump Hosts Meme Coin Gala
B: President Donald Trump hosted his third cryptocurrency gala for top holders of his meme coin at the Trump National golf club in Sterling, Virginia, on Sunday night. The event brought together a couple dozen men in suits and featured speeches from boxing champion Floyd Mayweather, Shark Tank investor Kevin O'Leary, and former NBA star Tristan Thompson.
B: Attendees received gift bags containing Victory perfume, a Coin Club bookmark, and a hat printed with the $TRUMP token name. The token has fallen below $1 after reaching a high of $75 on January 19, 2025.
A: Organizers indicated that 185 crypto wallets met the criteria for entry based on time-weighted holdings from September 30 to November 16, though the coin club website leaderboard listed just 130 wallets holding a combined $8.6 million. That figure contrasts with a May 2025 gala that featured 220 attendees holding $148 million, including crypto billionaire Justin Sun, whose individual wallet held $18.5 million at that time.
B: Data gathered by consumer advocacy group Public Citizen for Reuters indicates that more than half of the wallets qualifying for the recent event belonged to foreign nationals through crypto exchanges barring United States users. Trump maintained that his cryptocurrency support aims to boost American economic competitiveness, stating that China would dominate the sector otherwise.
A: The Trump family has earned at least $635 million from the $TRUMP token according to a June financial disclosure, and $2.3 billion across four crypto-related businesses from the beginning of the second term through April. Meanwhile, Democratic lawmakers stated plans to investigate potential conflicts of interest regarding the president's business ventures. CNBC and Reuters detailed specific figures regarding the number of qualifying wallets and total holdings compared to the May 2025 gala, while other outlets gave less numerical depth on the event metrics.

## DESK
A: The rest of the desk.
A: Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed stated that he is open to working with President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance to enact universal healthcare under the name TrumpCare, arguing that the title does not matter if it guarantees coverage for all Americans.
B: Russian forces launched a massive aerial assault involving 153 attack and decoy drones against railway, energy, and civilian infrastructure across 12 oblasts and Kyiv, killing at least six people and injuring 32 others.
A: Israeli political leaders and officials condemned a wave of arson attacks and vandalism carried out by Jewish extremists in Palestinian villages across the occupied West Bank, primarily in the Ramallah area and the South Hebron Hills, where vehicles were torched and racist graffiti was sprayed.
B: Washington state and local leaders sharply rebuked Immigration and Customs Enforcement after masked federal officers detained two passengers on a crowded jet bridge at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport. The incident occurred on Saturday morning as passengers were boarding an Alaska Airlines flight bound for Los Angeles, causing a distressing scene that delayed the flight.
A: Indonesian emergency services recovered twenty-four body bags from the burnt wreckage of a confectionery factory in Banten province following a weekend fire. The blaze broke out on Saturday night at a building within the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia complex located in Cikande in Serang district, roughly an hour drive west of Jakarta.
B: Malaysia has asked the government to clarify its position on Rohingya refugees and whether it will continue deporting Myanmar nationals following the International Court of Justice ruling that Myanmar committed genocide. The Foreign Ministry stated that Malaysia respects the November 19 judgment delivered in the genocide case brought by The Gambia against Myanmar.
A: Delegations from Yashar and Likud met on Sunday for a third round of negotiations to form a unity government following the October 27 elections, concluding without an agreement. Yashar party chairman Gadi Eisenkot and caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu discussed the state commission of inquiry and judicial overhaul laws, but postponed discussions on a rotation agreement.
B: President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed that Ukrainian forces deployed seven Ukrainian-made naval drones to strike a Russian warship and a dry cargo vessel in the Mediterranean Sea on Sunday. The operation targeted the Russian corvette Merkury and the cargo vessel MV Angara at the port of Benghazi in eastern Libya.

## CLOSE
A: That's On Air from Void News. Every source, every story, at Void News.
opinion_text:
One hundred eighty-five crypto wallets met the criteria for entry based on time-weighted holdings between September 30 and November 16, though the official website leaderboard listed just 130 wallets holding a combined 8.6 million dollars. That total stands in stark contrast to the May 2025 inaugural gala, which drew 220 wealthy investors holding 148 million dollars. The token itself once peaked at 75 dollars before falling to a record low of under 1 dollar.

Celebrity guests including Kevin O'Leary and Floyd Mayweather joined the room, while organizers cited a grander national purpose for the asset. The host told attendees that his motivation for supporting the cryptocurrency was to boost the economic competitiveness of the United States and prevent foreign dominance in the market.

We witness here the collision of sovereign authority and speculative retail finance, a merging of statecraft and digital tokenomics that demands sober institutional evaluation. When public office becomes intertwined with volatile speculative assets, we abandon the steady architecture of governance for the whims of unregulated markets.

Pragmatism requires us to separate grandiose geopolitical justifications from the mechanical reality of market depreciation. We have seen speculative manias before, but anchoring executive prestige to a falling digital coin introduces a distinct hazard to public trust. Institutional stability depends on clear boundaries between official duties and private financial promotion.

We must acknowledge the counterargument that financial innovation requires unorthodox participation and that digital assets represent a new frontier of economic competition. Markets evolve through experimentation, and governments frequently lag behind technological shifts.

Yet the trade-off remains unforgiving. As the pool of capital shrinks from 148 million dollars to 8.6 million dollars, the beneficiaries are no longer a broad market but a dwindling handful of concentrated holders meeting in private clubs. We weaken our financial system not by avoiding new technologies, but by attaching public authority to speculative instruments that inevitably collapse under the weight of their own detachment from productive enterprise. The ledger records the price, and the price tells the true story of where this experiment leads.
